_source: Job description § Customer Communication — every template must identify the company as Ruzik and must not claim to be human if directly asked.

initial_acknowledgment.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, thanks for reaching out to Ruzik Appliance Repair! We've got your request and will follow up shortly with next steps.

information_request.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, this is Ruzik Appliance Repair. To get you scheduled we just need a bit more info: {{missingFields}}. Reply here whenever you get a chance.

appointment_confirmation.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, you're confirmed with Ruzik Appliance Repair for {{window}}. {{technicianName}} will be your technician. Reply RESCHEDULE if this window no longer works.

appointment_reminder.body: Reminder from Ruzik Appliance Repair: your appointment is {{window}}. Reply RESCHEDULE if you need to change it.

technician_on_the_way.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, this is Ruzik Appliance Repair — {{technicianName}} is on the way, ETA about {{etaMinutes}} minutes.

rescheduling.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, Ruzik Appliance Repair here — you're rescheduled to {{newWindow}}. Let us know if that doesn't work.

waiting_for_parts.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, update from Ruzik Appliance Repair: we're waiting on {{partDescription}} for your repair. We'll update you again by {{expectedUpdateDate}}.

completion_followup.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, thanks for choosing Ruzik Appliance Repair! Your service is complete. Let us know if you have any questions about the work performed.

review_request.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, glad we could help! If you have a minute, a review means a lot to us as a small business: {{reviewLink}} — Ruzik Appliance Repair

warranty_followup.body: Hi {{customerFirstName}}, this is Ruzik Appliance Repair checking in — your repair is still under warranty until {{warrantyExpires}}. Let us know if the issue has returned.

disclosureRule: If a customer directly asks whether they are talking to a person or an AI, the response must truthfully state it is an automated assistant for Ruzik Appliance Repair and offer to connect them to Isaac. This is a hardcoded non-negotiable, not a template — enforced in src/guardrails, not skippable by prompting.
